author: Inside Edition
description: A roommate sprayed what looked like a can of Raid all over the kitchen. He drenched food and cooking items with the spray. His roommates say for months they have been suffering from mystery medical ailments. They did not know what was wrong until they say they caught their roommate in the act on a home surveillance camera. Now they fear they have been poisoned. Timothy Bradbury was arrested on charges related to poisoning of food, drink, medicine, or water with intent to cause injury.
title: Did This Man Try To Poison His Roommates With Bug Spray?

author: Inside Edition
description: A baby girl faced a scary medical condition. A strange growth suddenly appeared on her forehead. A week after Emory Risner was born, her parents Bree and Brody noticed a red mark. At 7 months old, Emory was diagnosed with a hemangioma, a non-cancerous tumor. Bree watched a 2025 Inside Edition story about a girl named Carolin who had large hemangiomas. The Risner family flew to New York City for a life changing procedure at Northwell Manhattan Eye, Ear, and Throat.
title: Baby Girl Gets Undergoes Surgery To Remove Hemangioma

author: Inside Edition
description: There is growing outrage over a serial child predator who is about to be released. David Allen Funston was convicted of 16 counts of kidnapping and child molestation in Sacramento in 1999. Now, after 27 years behind bars, he has been granted what's known in California as elderly parole. Funston is 64 years old. The parole board cited Funston's "therapy work and sex offender treatment classes he completed" behind bars. They said they "did not believe Funston posed a significant danger."
title: Outrage As Serial Child Predator Set To Be Released From Prison

author: Inside Edition
description: A child was dropped off a second story patio to save her from a house fire. The Milpitas Police Department in California released bodycam video from a responding officer. They say a family was sheltering from the flames on a second floor patio, but the flames were spreading and officers knew they had to start getting people out. They convinced a terrified mother to drop her child, promising they would catch her. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 3-Year-Old Girl Dropped From Second Floor Patio During House Fire
